name: coalgob
description: CoalGob — checks every destructive command an agent runs, per operation, for whether it already lands somewhere recoverable (the OS's own trash, or a destroyer that already snapshotted it), and only blocks it when it would not, handing back the recoverable form of the same destruction. Beta: the command-classifier engine (parser and tokenizer) and its test suite ship; there is no hook, skill, command, or interception surface yet.
